problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: volume 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: volume 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: volume 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: volume 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: volume 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: volume 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: volume 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: volume 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: volume 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: volume 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: volume 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: volume 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: volume 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: volume 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: volume 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: volume 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: volume 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: volume 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: volume 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: volume 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: volume 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: volume 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: volume 61 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
